title: Accepting a type writes `Name::` inside an expression and `Name()` after `new`, and the name alone wherever a type or a statement may start
scope:
what a type's completion item inserts, which names are offered after `new`, and which
positions are read as a written type. What is offered at a bare position, the ranking and the `use` line
are [0193](0193.md)'s and unchanged.
validatedBy:
`crates/nvs-lsp/tests/completion_edits.rs`, `crates/nvs-lsp/tests/handshake.rs`, and
the three cases under `tests/lsp/completion/` that cite the rule this creates.
